An administrative membership alone cannot accept spatial records; hidden UI buttons are not the enforcement.
Original file bytes are preserved and a finalized source cannot be altered through its staging upload; partial/mismatched content is not finalized.
Repeated finalization with the same logical operation/payload creates one source revision; a changed payload under that key is rejected.
Unauthorized original/preview reads fail; an expired temporary read link can be renewed after authorization without changing source identity.

r1 is received but cannot support the missing lower-limit evidence. r2 still needs suitability/binding; a guessed number does not satisfy the evidence policy.
A registered source reaches the actual private processor through a recoverable application job; output names the exact input fingerprint.
Duplicate job completion is harmless; failures are actionable; output for an old snapshot remains attached there and cannot ready a newer snapshot.
Stored unit footprint and Z limits reconstruct the supported prism; area/height/volume include frame, method and units.

Explicit correction to 3.0 m removes positive interior overlap; boundary contact remains distinct.
BSM-01 is −3–0 m in the local benchmark; common circulation remains separate; containment and boundary contact are not universal clashes.
Self-intersecting/nonfinite/degenerate/unsupported footprints and incompatible or unknown calculation references fail visibly; no silent transform or arbitrary-solid claim.
A differently sized/positioned rectangle pair has independently calculated contact/overlap outcomes; the engine does not branch on C-001/U03 names.
Selecting U03 links tree/plan/3D/details and opens footprint/lower/upper/alignment evidence with source revision/locator; the finding opens a next action.
User can edit a supported outline and lower/upper limits, save a new candidate and rerun checks; this is not only a static seeded scene.
View changes do not modify stored geometry/quantities; schematic placement is visibly synthetic/local and not exported as a surveyed geolocation.
Empty, loading, invalid, denied, processing failure, expired read and stale-edit states lead to useful recovery and do not show false success.
RQ-LEVEL-01 identifies case/component/required evidence/reference and assigned recipient; an unauthorized assignment/response is denied.
On an actual Android device, the assigned officer authenticates, opens the request, attaches r2/note and receives the same response/source IDs visible on web.
Authorized mobile administrator sees permitted task progress/assignment; other users cannot perform those actions; no final native acceptance route is exposed.
Network/picker/upload failure is visible; retry uses the intended operation identity and produces at most one response. Offline durability is not advertised.
r2 receipt alone does not rebind consumers. Explicit binding/correction creates new U03/U04 evidence snapshots as needed; U04 still needs fresh checks despite equal coordinates.
Missing mandatory evidence, missing relationship requirements or stale checks cannot be bypassed by a UI ready flag or client-supplied accepted state.
A distinct authorized reviewer accepts the exact submitted snapshot; self/wrong-role/cross-project approval fails; return/reason is supported.
Changes to relevant source/binding/evidence/relationship/policy/authority state between submission and decision cannot silently inherit old approval.
Controlled interleaving of neighbor insertion/update and decision uses the shared protection strategy; an unchecked neighbor cannot race into an accepted conflicting snapshot.
Repeated decision/issuance resolves one stable prototype identity; geometry correction does not replace identity; supplied external ULPIN is not regenerated.
Clean seed has no accepted unit. After real acceptance, refresh/relogin and permitted lookup return the same accepted revision/history; a later working edit leaves it intact.
From draft-only seed, real source intake, compute, evidence request/native response, correction, new checks, review and lookup form one continuous case with no core mocks.
After documented service restart and clean client login, persisted originals, candidate/accepted records, identity and access behavior remain correct.
The manual application runs without inference/API keys. Enabled inputs/actions really work; offline/heavy AI/IFC/planning/exchange are marked deferred, not mocked as live.
Primary web controls work with keyboard/focus and a narrow viewport; native task flow handles scrolling, keyboard and attachments.
A/B/V tasks name real delivered paths/interfaces, setup and acceptance criteria; remaining MVP gaps and later phases are distinct; usage evidence is observed or unknown.
